country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pulsant Milton Keynes data centre expansion
notes: Pulsant completed construction of a GBP10m high-density AI data hall at its Milton Keynes site, adding 1.2MW of capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pulsant Newcastle Central NE-1
notes: Operational central Newcastle colocation facility at 5 Stepney Lane, listed with 0.5MW IT load and 220 racks; originally opened under Onyx and now operated by Pulsant.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Norwich Apex data centre
notes: Proposed circa 150MW data centre campus on 13 hectares off Ipswich Road in Norwich; developer site says no formal planning approval has been obtained yet.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Norwich Research Park Data Centre
developer: Norwich Research Park / Earlham Institute ecosystem
notes: Norwich Research Park reported that a new state-of-the-art data centre had been given the green light for construction to bolster UK bioscience capability; public source did not state MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: NorwichDC Long Stratton facility
notes: Operational Norfolk colocation/dedicated-server/VPS facility in Long Stratton; public source does not disclose MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Humber Tech Park
developer: Humber Tech Park Ltd / Greystoke Land
notes: AI data centre campus near South Killingholme; developer states planning permission was granted in summer 2024. Planning documents/trade reporting describe up to 384MW IT load across three data centre buildings.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Elsham Tech Park AI data centre campus
developer: Greystoke Land / Elsham Tech Park interests
notes: Large AI data centre campus at/near Elsham Wolds Industrial Estate. Public reporting says planning permission was granted in 2026 and describes up to 1GW capacity on about 435 acres.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: AI Pathfinder Northamptonshire / Chelveston data centre
notes: AI Pathfinder announced a GBP3.4bn Northamptonshire AI data centre, publicly associated with Chelveston; first phase was claimed for late 2025, but public sources reviewed did not provide a clear MW capacity or confirmed planning status.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Safenames Wellingborough Data Centre
notes: Operational former Nationwide data centre in Wellingborough, reopened in 2015; listed as 2MW total.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Garrison Data Centre / Lloyds Horizon Data Centre
notes: Operational 50-acre data-centre campus in Corby referenced by contractor Careys as Garrison Data Centre and in local decarbonisation documentation as Lloyds Horizon Data Centre; capacity not publicly stated in reviewed sources.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Stellium Cobalt Park data centre campus
notes: Operational Cobalt Business Park data centre campus in Wallsend/North Tyneside, marketed by Stellium as a major carrier-neutral colocation and connectivity hub; Cobalt Park lists a secure campus of three data centres.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Stargate UK / Cobalt Park AI data centre
notes: UK government announced a North East AI Growth Zone including Cobalt Park near Newcastle in September 2025. Subsequent specialist reporting in April 2026 said OpenAI had paused the multi-billion-pound North Tyneside Stargate UK data-centre project, so status is recorded as unknown rather than planned or rejected.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Microsoft Eggborough data centre campus
notes: Microsoft proposed a two-building data centre campus on part of the former Eggborough Power Station site in North Yorkshire, with planning targeted for mid-2024 and construction targeted for early 2027; reviewed public sources did not state MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Drax Selby data centre
notes: Drax submitted plans for a first-phase circa 100MW data centre at Drax Power Station near Selby, with longer-term options reported at up to or over 1GW using existing power-station infrastructure.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: QTS Cambois Data Centre Campus
developer: QTS Data Centers / Blackstone-backed Renaissance Land
notes: GBP10bn data centre campus at Northumberland Energy Park, Cambois/Blyth. Council and project sources report planning progress and enabling works; Ridge states ten halls with combined capacity of 720MW and 540,000 sqm internal area.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Wansbeck Regeneration West Sleekburn data centre campus
notes: Planning application submitted for a GBP3.8bn data centre campus on a former GlaxoSmithKline site near the QTS Cambois campus in Northumberland; public source reviewed describes three data centre buildings but did not state MW capacity.
